objective: Allow full-resolution Android Wall photos to draw and promote after existing valid load plus onDisplay while keeping private low-res preview visible until ready
productionBaselineEvidence: 2026-10-31 user screenshots at 11:16 PHT show blurred public Wall photo against clear fullscreen. Last verified OTA was source 7b0e8081a2c82021c27e8fbee26f318c7eb9f460, runtime 1.3.2; current main includes subsequent scoped Wall changes. chosenApproach: Place sharp original at alpha 1 under existing direct preview via zIndex 0 versus 1. Only raise original to zIndex 2 after verified signed URL, valid decoded dimensions, and matching Expo onDisplay (or native valid onLoad fallback).
selectionRationale: Fixes possible Android transparency/display acknowledgement deadlock without removing verification or changing first-paint geometry; reuses original cache, protected signer, and existing retry architecture.
alternativeApproaches: Expose original on decoder load alone: rejected due historical blank tiles
Remove low-res previews: rejected due costly and slow mobile data
Force reveal by timer: rejected because missing image could mask preview
preserveBehaviors: Signed URLs and per-account storage access unchanged
Decode+onDisplay URL/renderer gate and native fallback unchanged
No new APK or native runtime
acceptanceChecks: Unready original renders alpha 1 at zIndex 0 below preview zIndex 1
Ready original rises to zIndex 2 without remount
Both Expo and native original paths use same layering
